payload.text: With PREZ_THEME_DUPLICATES=refuse, a theme name that two directories on the search path define is refused, byte-identical copies included: exit 2, a message beginning theme '<name>' is defined more than once, each definition named with its directory and the mechanism that put that directory on the path, listed in search order, and no output written. Answers AC05: a name that two directories define refuses and names both. Red-first: HEAD builds it.
